content: उत्थित {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Risen or rising (as from a seat); वचो निशम्योत्थितमुत्थितः सन् <ls>R. 2. 61</ls>, <ls n="R.">7. 10</ls>, <ls n="R.">3. 61</ls>; <ls>Ku. 7. 61</ls>; बिल्वोत्थितां भूमिमिवोरगाणाम् <ls>Śi. 1. 15</ls>. .²2 Raised, gone up; पांशुः <ls>Śi. 5. 11</ls>; <ls>R. 6. 33</ls>; <ls>Śi. 4. 1</ls>, <ls n="Śi.">17. 7</ls>. .²3 Rescued, saved, <ls>Ratn. 4</ls>. .²4 Born, produced, sprung up, arisen; वचः <ls>R. 2. 61</ls>, <ls n="R.">12. 49</ls>; broken out (as fire); अग्निः <ls>Ratn. 4. 14</ls>; हृदयेऽग्निरिवोत्थितः <ls>R. 4. 2</ls>. burst into a flame. .²5 Striving, active, diligent; <ls>Kām. 1. 17</ls>, <ls n="Kām.">8. 49</ls>. .²6 Increasing, growing (in strength), advancing. .²7 Bounded up, rebounded; पतिता उत्थिता <ls>Mu. 1</ls>. .²8 Occurring. .²9 High, lofty, eminent. .²10 Extended, stretched; आपर्वभाग˚ <ls>Ś. 4. 5</ls>. .²11 An epithet of a Pragātha consisting of ten Pādas. .{@-तम्@} Rising, arising; शुनं नो अस्तु चरितमुत्थितं च <ls>Av. 3. 15. 4</ls>.
